settings.label: Cart note on the cart page
Customer tag of approved business customers
settings.info: You approve a company by adding this tag to its customer in the Shopify admin (Customers).

settings.label: B2B verification service URL (optional)
settings.info: Leave empty (default): registrations are sent to the store inbox and the B2B page's log-in tab only shows a hint, since nothing can check it yet. Fill this in to run the optional b2b-verify-service (see its README): every registration then waits in its admin panel for you to approve or reject, and an approved company logs in on the B2B page with its e-mail + OIB (no Shopify account, no password). Use the /register URL, e.g. https://<your-service>/api/b2b/register - the theme derives the log-in and session-check URLs from it automatically.

settings.label: Wholesale price list (SKU:price:pieces per box:grams per piece)
settings.info: One line per product variant SKU: SKU:PRICE:BOX:GRAMS, e.g. NP000001:19.00:36:125 - PRICE per piece EXCLUDING VAT in the shop's currency, BOX = pieces per carton, GRAMS = net weight of one piece (the carton weight shown to B2B customers is BOX x GRAMS). B2B customers see this price (marked excl. VAT) and buy whole cartons only (1 = one carton of BOX pieces); leave :BOX out to sell single pieces. A SKU not listed here falls back to the wholesale discount % below, or to the regular price if that is also 0. With the B2B verification service configured, a signed-in company's cart checks out through a draft order at exactly these prices plus VAT (the service reads this list); without it, it is display only.

settings.label: Wholesale discount shown on prices (fallback)
settings.info: Used only for a SKU that isn't in the price list above. 0 = do not show wholesale prices for those. Only use this when a matching automatic discount for customers with the tag exists in Shopify - the storefront price is informational, the discount itself is applied by Shopify at checkout.

settings.label: B2B minimum order value
settings.info: Shown and enforced on the cart page for B2B customers only (checkout stays disabled below this), compared with the cart's wholesale value. Major units in the shop's currency, same as the price list, e.g. 11000. Carts in a currency listed below use that fixed amount instead; any other currency gets this one converted. 0 = no minimum.

settings.label: B2B minimum order per currency
settings.info: Optional, one line per currency: CURRENCY:AMOUNT, e.g. EUR:1000. A cart in that currency must reach exactly this amount (no exchange-rate drift). The B2B checkout of the verification service uses the line for the shop's currency, if any.

settings.content: B2B only, and only with the verification service configured (it puts the pallet shipping on the B2B draft order, so Shopify's checkout charges exactly what the cart shows). Cartons per product = the price list's pieces per carton; the cartons are packed onto pallets (rotation, layers, mixed carton types) and the company pays pallets × the price below. Retail customers are not affected.

settings.label: Carton dimensions (pieces per carton:L×W×H cm)
settings.info: One line per carton size of the price list, e.g. 36:40x30x18. The line * is used for every other carton size and for products sold per piece (counted as cartons of 20 pieces). Add a line for any other carton size in the price list (e.g. 12, 24, 40) to count it exactly.

settings.label: Shipping price per pallet
settings.info: The first line is the price per pallet, e.g. EUR:100. Every B2B customer sees and pays it in the currency they shop in, converted at the day's ECB reference rate by the verification service (100 EUR -> SEK, PLN, DKK, ...); the checkout charges exactly the converted amount. Add a line CURRENCY:AMOUNT only to fix the price for one currency instead of converting it, e.g. SEK:1150.

settings.label: Cookie banner
settings.info: Connected to Shopify's Customer Privacy API. Turn it off if you use Shopify's built-in cookie banner instead.
